title: Forcing Quasirandomness via Rooted F-Densities
summary: Let $F$ be a finite graph with at least one edge, and let $W$ be a graphon. We show that if the density of $F$ rooted at each edge is almost everywhere constant, then either $t(F,W)=0$ or $W$ is constant. For edge-transitive $F$, one rooted equation suffices. This recovers the edge-rooted triangle theorem of Reiher and Schacht. In their terminology, our result also shows that every clique is $2$-forcing, answering a question they posed.
